engine: cloud stdlib Fraction + exact Python LLL
limitations: Selected patches only, not full-shell coverage or a new mathematical exclusion.
Timings exclude interprocess transport, serialization, GPU work, and persistent coordinator.
The default runtime uses Python Fraction/LLL, not ADA mpq/fpylll.
Both implementations share patch mathematics; local controls are independently searched, not an independent whole-shell oracle.
